secondary.candidate_volume_units: SSE_STAR shares; other sampled A-share boards lots times 100
secondary.sdk_unit_limitation: Pinned SDK excludes sz000 from lot conversion; candidate corrects this explicitly, not silently
secondary.amount_units: Decimal(raw upstream field 8) * Decimal(10000); never multiply SDK-normalized output again

selection_order: Reuse already successful checksum-pinned primary partition without refetch
For new work use accepted primary only when operationally healthy
For persisted qualifying primary failure with exhausted bounded budget, use secondary only if independent authority and cross-source parity are PASS
Otherwise keep UNRESOLVED_REQUIRED_DATA; do not publish
price_parity: Exact Decimal OHLC and dates; any material difference blocks
amount_parity: Human-authorized decision-invariance acceptance, not exact tick parity or a claimed rounding mode

amount_precision.uncertainty_interval: [max(0,A-100), A+100] CNY, closed union of floor/ceiling/nearest quantization cells
amount_precision.boundary: Existing 20 non-null observations, arithmetic mean >= 10000000 CNY; unchanged
amount_precision.decision_schedule: Completed session 253 then every 20 accepted calendar sessions; existing include_st=false
amount_precision.admission: Every recovered security must have zero ambiguous potentially evaluated amount decisions; stop and retain affected set otherwise
amount_precision.cross_source_guard: Any observed discrepancy outside the precision interval fails separately; no bound on unrelated aggregation errors is claimed
amount_precision.raw_value: Original upstream strings and response hashes retained; no imputation or fabricated precision

volume_parity: Exact shares except explicitly recorded STAR share-to-whole-lot rounding (half quantum 50 shares)
dataset_publication: Complete required data and established quality gates only
